synopsis: ISO/IEC TS 22440-3 is the “Examples of application” part of an AI functional safety series whose other parts cover requirements and guidance; all three remained committee drafts in 2026 [f2384, f2728, f15300]. The drafts were registered on 9 February 2026, and their comment period closed on 11 April 2026 [f2385]. Chapter 3 and the glossary agree that publication much before 2027 or 2028 is unlikely, but this is an uncertain forecast rather than a confirmed publication date [f2386, f15300]. The series’ testing provisions therefore remain draft provisions, rather than finalized acceptance criteria [f2729].
